about: Queue for the Solid Core (Core) mannequin clips, generated in the Gemini web app the same way as the Open Hips clips (Create video, Portrait, text only, one new chat per clip). DRAFT: the program in content/programs/core.ts and these pose descriptions were written by Claude from general coaching knowledge; Felipe has not checked them yet.
template: A smooth beige 3D anatomy mannequin, male, faceless with no eyes and no mouth, visible ball joints at shoulders, elbows, wrists, knees and ankles, athletic build, wearing only black shorts, white crew socks and white sneakers. Dark gym, black rubber floor, neon green rim light from the right, nobody else in the room. {view}, static camera that never moves, entire body in frame, no tripod or camera equipment anywhere in the room. He starts already in this position: {start} He does only one movement: {motion} Exactly 3 slow repetitions, then he holds still in the starting position. He never changes position and never does any other movement. Working muscles: {glow}. They light up as glowing neon green anatomical muscle fibers drawn as a graphic overlay on top of the body and on top of the black shorts, so wherever a working muscle is under the shorts its glow shows on the shorts too, with visible fiber strands in the real shape of each muscle, brightest while the muscle works and dimmer when it rests. No red or skinless muscle anywhere: outside the green glow the body stays smooth plain beige. No cuts, no text. Portrait 9:16.
run_rules: Same run rules as assets/glossary/hips-queue.json (read its run_rules). Clips for this program go to public/programs/core/clips/<exercise-slug>.mp4 and are listed in content/programs/program-clips.ts under "core".

clips.name: Dead Bug
clips.start: lying on his back, lower back pressed into the floor, both arms pointing straight up at the ceiling, both knees bent at 90 degrees above the hips with the shins parallel to the floor.
clips.motion: keeping the lower back pressed into the floor, he slowly lowers only the left arm overhead toward the floor while straightening only the right leg until the right heel hovers just above the floor, pauses, then brings both back to the start. He uses only the left arm and the right leg every time and never switches to the other arm or leg.
clips.glow: only the abs, the long flat muscles on the front of the belly from the bottom of the ribs all the way down under the waistband of the shorts, with the bottom part glowing on the black shorts. No glow on the arms or legs. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Reverse Crunch
clips.start: lying on his back, arms flat on the floor by his sides with the palms down, knees bent at 90 degrees above the hips with the shins parallel to the floor.
clips.motion: keeping the knee angle fixed and the arms on the floor, he curls his hips off the floor and draws the knees toward his chest, pauses, then lowers the hips slowly back down. His head and shoulders stay on the floor and he never swings the legs.
clips.glow: only the abs, the long flat muscles on the front of the belly from the bottom of the ribs all the way down under the waistband of the shorts, with the bottom part glowing on the black shorts, brightest on the lower belly. No glow on the arms or legs. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Forearm Plank
clips.start: in a forearm plank: elbows under the shoulders, forearms flat on the floor and parallel, legs straight, up on the toes, body in one straight line from head to heels.
clips.motion: holding the plank perfectly still, he tucks the tailbone slightly and squeezes the belly tight, pauses, then relaxes the squeeze a little. The body barely moves: he never lifts the hips high and never drops to the knees.
clips.glow: only the abs, the long flat muscles on the front of the belly from the bottom of the ribs all the way down under the waistband of the shorts, with the bottom part glowing on the black shorts, and the obliques on both sides of the waist. No glow on the arms or legs. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Side Plank
clips.start: in a side plank on the right forearm: right elbow under the right shoulder, legs straight and stacked with the left foot on top of the right, hips lifted so the body is one straight line from head to feet, left hand on the left hip.
clips.motion: keeping the right forearm planted and the body in one line, he lifts the hips a little higher and squeezes, pauses, then eases back to the straight line. He never lowers the hips to the floor and never turns to the other side.
clips.glow: only the right obliques, the muscles on the right side of the waist from the bottom of the ribs down to the right hip, and the right side of the abs. No glow on the left side, the arms or the legs. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Bird Dog
clips.start: on all fours, hands under shoulders, knees under hips, back flat, head in line with the spine.
clips.motion: keeping the back flat and the hips level, he reaches only the left arm straight forward and only the right leg straight back until both are level with his back, pauses, then brings the left hand and right knee back to the floor. He uses only the left arm and the right leg every time and never switches sides.
clips.glow: only the abs on the front of the belly, the long muscles along both sides of the lower spine, and the right glute under the shorts, glowing on the black shorts. No glow on the arms. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Bear Hold
clips.start: on all fours with the hands under the shoulders, knees under the hips and resting on the floor, up on the toes, back flat.
clips.motion: keeping the back flat and the hands and toes planted, he lifts both knees about 5 centimetres off the floor, holds them hovering, then sets them back down. He never stands up and never crawls.
clips.glow: only the abs, the long flat muscles on the front of the belly from the bottom of the ribs all the way down under the waistband of the shorts, with the bottom part glowing on the black shorts, and the front of both shoulders. No glow on the back or the legs. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Lying Leg Raises
clips.start: lying on his back, legs straight and together with the heels just above the floor, arms flat by his sides with the palms down.
clips.motion: keeping both legs straight and together and the lower back pressed down, he raises the legs until they point at the ceiling, pauses, then lowers them slowly until the heels hover just above the floor again. He never sits up.
clips.glow: only the abs, the long flat muscles on the front of the belly from the bottom of the ribs all the way down under the waistband of the shorts, with the bottom part glowing on the black shorts, and the front of both hips. No glow on the arms or the front of the thighs. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Side Plank Hip Dips
clips.start: in a side plank on the right forearm: right elbow under the right shoulder, legs straight and stacked with the left foot on top of the right, hips lifted so the body is one straight line from head to feet, left hand on the left hip.
clips.motion: keeping the right forearm planted and the feet stacked, he lowers the hips until the right hip almost touches the floor, then lifts them back up to the straight line. He never turns to the other side.
clips.glow: only the right obliques, the muscles on the right side of the waist from the bottom of the ribs down to the right hip. No glow on the left side, the arms or the legs. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Seated Knee Tucks
clips.start: sitting on the floor leaning back about 45 degrees, hands on the floor behind the hips with the fingers pointing forward, legs straight out in front with the heels just off the floor.
clips.motion: keeping the hands planted and the heels off the floor, he pulls both knees in toward his chest while lifting the chest slightly, pauses, then pushes both legs back out straight. The feet never touch the floor.
clips.glow: only the abs, the long flat muscles on the front of the belly from the bottom of the ribs all the way down under the waistband of the shorts, with the bottom part glowing on the black shorts. No glow on the arms or legs. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Hollow Body Hold
clips.start: lying on his back with the lower back pressed into the floor, arms straight overhead beside the ears, legs straight and together, shoulders and feet lifted a few centimetres off the floor so the body makes a shallow banana shape.
clips.motion: keeping the lower back glued to the floor, he lowers the arms and legs a little closer to the floor, pauses, then lifts them back to the start position. He never sits up, never rocks and never lets the feet touch the floor.
clips.glow: only the abs, the long flat muscles on the front of the belly from the bottom of the ribs all the way down under the waistband of the shorts, with the bottom part glowing on the black shorts. No glow on the arms or legs. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Hollow Rocks
clips.start: lying on his back in a hollow body shape: lower back pressed into the floor, arms straight overhead beside the ears, legs straight and together, shoulders and feet a few centimetres off the floor.
clips.motion: holding that exact banana shape without bending at the hips or knees, he rocks back onto his upper back so the feet rise, then rocks forward onto his lower back so the shoulders rise, like a rocking chair. The body shape never changes and he never sits up.
clips.glow: only the abs, the long flat muscles on the front of the belly from the bottom of the ribs all the way down under the waistband of the shorts, with the bottom part glowing on the black shorts. No glow on the arms or legs. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Tuck L-Sit Lifts
clips.start: sitting on the floor with the knees bent and pulled in toward the chest, feet flat on the floor, hands flat on the floor right beside the hips with the fingers pointing forward, arms straight.
clips.motion: keeping the arms locked straight, he pushes the floor away so his hips and both feet lift off the floor with the knees tucked to the chest, holds for a moment, then lowers back down. He never swings forward and never kicks the legs out.
clips.glow: only the abs, the long flat muscles on the front of the belly from the bottom of the ribs all the way down under the waistband of the shorts, with the bottom part glowing on the black shorts, and the back of both upper arms (the triceps). No glow on the legs. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red
